title: 10 arrested, P1-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes seized in Caraga

blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Police in Caraga (Region 13) arrested 10 people after they were allegedly caught with nearly P1 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes in separate operations across the region last week, an official said. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13) director, said in a statement that the operations conducted from Sept. 20 to 27 were part of their intensified campaign against smuggled cigarettes. Among those arrested was alias “Norsan,” 40, a resident of Kawit 2, Barangay 1, Dapa, Surigao del Norte, who yielded 129 reams of suspected smuggled cigarettes valued at P161,250. READ: P14-M […]...
